items.title: Support ticket triage
items.summary: One call: department Choice, urgency Noul, frustration Score. Code sets priority and whether to auto-route.
steps: Send message + policy + open orders as structured state.
Fan out topic, refund-requested, spam signals, frustration.
Low topic confidence → human. Else route.

items.title: Guardrail in front of a chat model
items.summary: Screen inbound and outbound messages for jailbreak, credential harvest, and harm severity before a generative model runs.
steps: Noul: is this a jailbreak attempt?
Noul: does it request a secret?

items.title: Filter RAG passages
items.summary: Score each retrieved chunk for relevance, contradiction, and prompt injection. Only survivors reach the answering model.
steps: One Jev request per passage, or batched questions.
Flag contradictions instead of hiding them.

items.title: Citation check
items.summary: Choice: does the source span support the claim? Confidence below threshold → human review, not a silent pass.
steps: Ask one Choice with an explicit 'not enough context' option.
Route low confidence to a reviewer.

items.title: Verify a tool-call trace
items.summary: Do not ask 'was this trace correct?'. Ask one Noul per argument, schema, and unit match.
steps: Keep available_tools and the trace in state.
Atomic questions: right tool, args match schema, units match request.
Fail the step if any high-stakes Noul is low.
